why: This proof locks the false positive already measured in alicerce: the previous version looked for the literal words lint/typecheck/test in the YAML and failed every repository that aggregates verification into a single command. The pass side has a workflow that contains NONE of the three words — it calls only `npm run verificar`, which chains `estatica` (lint + typecheck) and `test`, exercising two levels of the expansion — and it has to PASS. The two package.json are byte for byte identical: the only variable is the workflow's `run:` line, so the fail side can only fail because the CI really does not reach the verification the repository has.
